hooks.name: Accessibility review for interactive components
hooks.description: Advisory review of accessibility concerns when React components are saved

action.prompt:
Review the saved file for potential accessibility issues based on the project's accessibility steering rules. This is an advisory review only, not an authoritative audit. Check for:

- Missing semantic HTML (divs used instead of buttons, nav, main, etc.)
- Missing accessible names on interactive elements
- Keyboard navigation gaps (onClick without onKeyDown)
- Missing focus management
- Missing aria-live regions for dynamic content
- Motion/animation without reduced-motion support

If the file touches the challenge sandbox (data-testid="challenge-sandbox"), note that intentional defects there are expected. Only flag issues in app shell code.

Keep the review brief and actionable. If no issues are found, say so in one sentence.
